text:
jules: FYI deploy-bot auto-tagged v7.0.0 for PR#6112. It only flipped a default behavior and added a hidden feature flag. I'm worried about accidental minors.

release-bot: auto-analysis: touched files: src/config/*, src/flags/*, docs/flags.md -> heuristic: source + docs -> default minor. Tagging rule: source edits -> minor unless override present.

renee: Hidden feature flag + default flip sounds like a user-visible change even if behind a flag. But we should distinguish "opt-in feature" vs "default change". Default flips are effectively breaking for anyone relying on old defaults.

pat: Agreed. If default behavior changes we should err toward minor or at least call it out prominently in release notes. However, deploy-bot should annotate the PR with the exact reason it picked minor. Too many surprises otherwise.

jules: This wasn't intentional; the flag was behind an env var that isn't set in prod yet. Still, if we're conservative we should leave it as patch and add a post-release announcement that we flipped a default in canary only.

ops-bot: policy note: default behavioral changes that alter runtime semantics are classified as minor for public releases. Patch allowed if change gated by a non-default runtime flag AND default not flipped in release branches.

renee: Maybe we need three outcomes: patch, minor, and minor-notice. Minor-notice = change classified minor but can be gated with a human approval to proceed. That could reduce auto-minors.

release-bot: suggestion implemented: new mode 'confirmed-minor' requires an approval from release-approvers before tagging. For now, manual override tokens accepted: [PATCH], [MINOR], [CONFIRM-MINOR].

pat: Also request: when auto-tagging, include a one-line "rationale" in the git tag and PR comment like "reason: default flip in config X". That helps triage.

jules: I'll retitle PR to include [PATCH] and add `semver: patch` frontmatter with a note about canary-only flip. Also will add a changelog snippet.

release-bot: actioned: PR retitled, forced patch tag v7.0.1 applied by @jules. Tag note: "reason: author override; default flip gated in canary only".

renee: Follow-up RFC idea: add a detector that flags default flips as higher-risk and requires a short checklist in PR body: "default changed? yes/no, flag gated? yes/no, migration required? yes/no". That would force authors to think through it.

pat: And playbook update: clarify semantics of "default flip" vs "opt-in feature" with examples so deploy-bot heuristics align with human intent.

jules: Filed RFC draft: https://git.internal/rex/rfcs/semver-default-flips. Closing thread, thanks all.
